lineage_note: Use smoothed suffix counts as the confidence reference, inspect document differences, and register a fresh comparison before fitting another confidence method.
summary: On 384 windows from twelve documents, native confidence had equal-document Brier error 1.071032. Empirical suffix counts scored 1.017686 and smoothed suffix counts 0.883474. Each method chose the same bytes and made 261 mistakes. This is a fixed-panel confidence diagnostic.
